title: Try new game Hitthetimer.com
author: Temporary_Manner1750
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I recently got hooked on those "stop the timer exactly on the millisecond" challenges, so I decided to code a full browser game based on it. It’s called HitTheTimer.

The core mechanic is simple: You get a random target time, you start the clock, the clock hides, and you have to press SPACE exactly when you think the time is up.

There are 5 modes, but I really want to challenge you guys to the Global Marathon:

You play 10 consecutive rounds.

Every millisecond you miss by is added to your total error.

Your final score is sent to a live Global Leaderboard. 🌍

There is also an Online/Local Survival mode and an "Impostor Mode" to play with friends.

The game is 100% free, runs instantly in the browser (mobile & desktop), and has ZERO ads. It's just a passion project (there's only a small tip jar if you feel generous).

You can play it here: www.hitthetimer.com

I would love to hear your feedback and see if anyone here can take the #1 spot on the leaderboard! Let me know your scores. 🎯
